answer: To claim a timber-cruise plot, the applicant cuts a core at the tree and posts a kernel: SHA-256 of the core photo, plot coordinates, and a noon-bowl nonce. It stays on the valley board 16 hours so a holder can flag familiar grain or a trail-camera gait. A hillside signal mast must receive a handheld burst from the plot GPS within four minutes of a random pager. A sponsor may back only one cruise claim per month. A repeated gait-hash or a 12-bit kernel-prefix collision with any live claim voids both filings and freezes the sponsor's cutting license for a season.
